description: 大约需要0.5h，来制作你的专属布贴作品吧。
About 0.5 hours — come create your own patch design.
booking_note: 布贴diy自动预约1小时，确定好到店时间即可。
Patch DIY automatically reserves 1 hour. Just choose your arrival time.
unavailable: 这里无法安排完整的1小时布贴体验，请选择其他到店时间。
A full 1-hour Patch DIY slot is not available here. Please choose another arrival time.
capacity: 布贴预约独立接待，每时段一组，待确认预约也占用时段。
Patch DIY has its own capacity: one group at a time. Pending requests also hold their slot.
timetable_help: 一组客人一个色块，点击查看详情；点击空白时段筛选预约。拼豆与布贴独立接待，布贴待确认预约也占用时段。
Each block is one group. Select it for details, or select an empty slot to filter bookings. Beadmaking and Patch DIY use separate capacity. Pending patch requests hold their slot.
timetable_all: 全部体验视图的时段底色显示拼豆余位；查看布贴空闲时段请选择“布贴DIY”。
In the all-experiences view, slot backgrounds show beadmaking availability. Choose Patch DIY to see its free slots.
duration_error: 布贴DIY每次固定预约1小时，请重新选择到店时间。
Patch DIY bookings must be exactly 1 hour. Please choose your arrival time again.
